title: rewards.account.frozen v1
description: Emitted after the fraud signal consumer flips a rewards account's status to frozen. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishAccountFrozen (internal/service/events_publisher.go:257, event_type stamped at line 258), called from FraudSignalConsumer (internal/service/fraud_consumer.go:473). Added 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards, option A2). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) -- fields are top-level, matching the real producer: cmd/server/boot.go:282/417 wire FraudSignalConsumer with the raw Redis-backed EventPublisher (w.publisher), so publish() (events_publisher.go:295) marshals the Event struct directly onto the 'payload' field of both the bare rewards.account.frozen stream and the events:rewards domain mirror. There is no event_version, producer, or data wrapper on this wire shape; occurred_at replaces the envelope's timestamp field. This producer never sets Amount, TransactionID, or BalanceAfter -- amount is always 0 on the wire (the Go int64 zero value; the json tag has no omitempty).

event_id.description: UUID identifying this event (auto-generated by EventPublisher.publish if the caller left it empty).

event_type.description: Stamped by PublishAccountFrozen. Consumers route on this exact value.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the frozen account.

user_id.description: Rewards member whose account was frozen.

account_id.description: Rewards account that was frozen (acc.ID). Always set by this producer.

transaction_id.description: Not set by this producer (account-level action, not a ledger transaction).

amount.description: Not applicable -- this producer never sets Amount. Always 0 on the wire.

reason.description: Freeze reason string passed by the fraud signal consumer (e.g. velocity_threshold_exceeded).

reference.description: Free-form reference taken from the inbound fraud signal envelope's 'reference' field, when present.

signal_id.description: Id of the inbound fraud signal (event_id field on the signal envelope) that triggered the freeze.

signal_score.description: Fraud score carried on the inbound signal envelope ('score' field). Type varies with the signal producer.
